title: CardioGuard: End-to-End Heart Disease Prediction System
one_line_summary: Clinical decision support system evaluating cardiac risk across multiple machine learning classifiers with an interactive Streamlit dashboard.
dataset: UCI Cleveland Heart Disease — 303 records, 14 features (13 clinical predictors + 1 binary target: 0 = no disease, 1 = disease)
task: Binary classification (presence vs absence of heart disease)
models_compared: Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, AdaBoost — 80/20 stratified split + 5-fold cross-validation
cross_validation_note: Presented honestly alongside test accuracy; the test set is small.
disclaimer: This project is for educational and research purposes only and does not constitute medical advice.

title: Diabetes Risk Prediction App
one_line_summary: Population-scale binary screening tool assessing diabetes risk using CDC BRFSS indicators and an ensemble learning architecture.
dataset: CDC BRFSS 2015 Diabetes Health Indicators — 253,681 rows, 22 columns
task: Binary classification — No Diabetes vs At Risk (prediabetes + diabetes merged). A 3-class version was tested first but the prediabetes class could not be detected reliably (severe class imbalance), so the final model is binary.
models_compared: Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, Decision Tree, SVM, AdaBoost; hyper-parameter tuning with GridSearchCV; multicollinearity check (VIF all < 2, so all features kept); feature engineering
champion_model: Ensemble of Random Forest + XGBoost + LightGBM (decision threshold 0.60)
honest_note: Performance plateaued around F1 ≈ 0.48 across every algorithm and feature set tried, which points to a limit of the dataset rather than of the models. The app is designed as a screening aid.
disclaimer: This project is for educational and research purposes only and does not constitute medical advice.

title: Breast Cancer Survival Prognosis
one_line_summary: Clinical survival prognosis system predicting overall survival status from patient clinical and pathological features.
task: Predict Overall Survival Status from clinical features
models_compared: XGBoost (winner), Random Forest, AdaBoost, Decision Tree — GridSearchCV + 5-fold stratified cross-validation
app_features: Model performance metrics and ROC analysis
disclaimer: This project is for educational and research purposes only and does not constitute medical advice.
